scenarios.currentBody: Marriott Hotels creates owner value on full-service conversions and new builds where guests expect a namesake brand experience—meetings capability, polished public space, and consistent service—not a corporate brochure story. Underwrite product and staffing to the flagship lane, and keep JW Marriott, Autograph, and Tribute out of the same diligence file. Value weakens when the asset cannot sustain full-service depth or when owners treat Marriott International as the brand itself.

proposedReplacement.title: Meetings-Capable Full-Service Assets
proposedReplacement.body: Marriott Hotels creates owner value on full-service assets where meeting inventory, polished public space, and banquet capacity can support group and bleisure demand. Affiliation strengthens commercial reach when the physical plant can host those programs day one. Owner value is weaker when the asset lacks meetings depth or when sponsors underwrite as if a soft-brand or lifestyle sibling were the same product.

scenarios.currentBody: Owner value rises when Marriott Hotels affiliation supports group and bleisure demand the physical plant can actually host. Diligence meeting inventory, F&B capacity, and operator depth before modeling commercial lift. CALA references such as Cancún and Mexico City help owners benchmark product and service scope against regional competitors rather than US-only comps.

proposedReplacement.title: Urban And Resort Public-Space Depth
proposedReplacement.body: Owner value rises on urban gateway and resort hotels with enough lobby, F&B, and guestroom quality to carry the namesake Marriott Hotels promise. Underwrite public-space and food-and-beverage capital so rate can reflect a full-service experience rather than a limited-service box. Capital returns hold when the asset’s service intensity matches the brand lane—not JW Marriott luxury or Autograph individuality.

scenarios.currentBody: Marriott Bonvoy and Marriott International distribution strengthen the commercial case only when the hotel can deliver Marriott Hotels standards day one. Sequence systems, training, and PIP with financing so affiliation does not outrun product readiness. Compare explicitly to Sheraton and Westin when the asset’s wellness, legacy, or meeting profile points to a sibling lane.

proposedReplacement.title: Confident Full-Service Conversion
proposedReplacement.body: Conversion and repositioning assets fit Marriott Hotels when owners need a globally recognized full-service flag without moving into luxury or soft-brand sibling territory. Affiliation helps when PIP, staffing, and product standards can deliver a credible Marriott Hotels stay. Value weakens if the capital plan cannot sustain full-service depth or if the thesis drifts toward Renaissance, Tribute, or Autograph positioning.

scenarios.currentBody: Sheraton creates owner value when sponsors reinvest in capable full-service shells—especially where meetings and social public space can be modernized into a credible brand experience. Underwrite PIP and operating intensity as full-service work, not select-service shortcuts. Keep Four Points by Sheraton and Four Points Flex out of the same underwriting lane.

proposedReplacement.title: Legacy Full-Service Repositioning
proposedReplacement.body: Sheraton creates owner value when sponsors reinvest in capable full-service shells—especially where meetings rooms, ballrooms, and arrival experience can be modernized into a credible brand stay. Underwrite PIP and operating intensity as full-service work, not select-service shortcuts. Owner value holds when the relaunch restores a recognizable Sheraton experience rather than a light midscale refresh.

scenarios.currentBody: Owner value strengthens when Sheraton affiliation supports local meetings, events, and bleisure demand the plant can host. Diligence banquet capacity, public-space programming, and operator depth before modeling lift. CALA resorts such as Cancún and Puerto Vallarta provide regional product references for full-service Sheraton delivery. Keep Sheraton product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the full-service Sheraton with legacy repositioning potential stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

proposedReplacement.title: Meetings And Community-Space Assets
proposedReplacement.body: Assets with banquet, social, and community-space capacity create Sheraton value when local meetings and bleisure demand need a full-service hub. Affiliation supports commercial lift when public-space programming and operator depth match the plant. Capital cases are stronger when the hotel can host events guests remember—not when meetings inventory is thin or under-capitalized.

scenarios.currentBody: Marriott Bonvoy distribution helps only when the hotel remains a true Sheraton, not a Flex-style conversion. Sequence standards, systems, and training so relaunch quality matches full-service expectations. Compare Marriott Hotels and Westin when the asset’s premium or wellness profile points elsewhere. Keep Sheraton product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the full-service Sheraton with legacy repositioning potential stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

proposedReplacement.title: Globally Recognized Full-Service Stability
proposedReplacement.body: Sheraton helps stabilize owner confidence in markets where a globally recognized full-service flag matters for lenders, partners, and transient demand. Underwrite service standards and public-space quality so the flag stays credible after cutover. Value is weaker when the asset’s product story is really Four Points or Four Points Flex—or when wellness-led premium better fits Westin.

scenarios.currentBody: Westin creates owner value when wellness is an underwritable product system—rooms, fitness, F&B cues, and service—not filler language. Diligence capital and staffing for premium full-service delivery, and separate the file from W Hotels lifestyle luxury and JW Marriott. CALA examples such as The Westin Resort & Spa, Cancun help owners see regional premium leisure execution.

proposedReplacement.title: Wellness-Led Premium Urban Or Resort
proposedReplacement.body: Westin creates owner value on premium urban and resort assets where wellness is a product system—rooms, fitness, sleep cues, and calm public space—not a marketing slogan. Affiliation fits when capital and staffing can deliver that restorative stay consistently. Owner value weakens when wellness is filler language or when the asset belongs in a lifestyle-luxury or meetings-led sibling lane.

scenarios.currentTitle: Urban And Resort Premium Demand Capture
scenarios.currentBody: Owner value rises in urban gateways and resort nodes where bleisure and leisure guests seek restorative stays. Underwrite public-space calm, fitness access, and rooms consistency before modeling affiliation lift. Compare Sheraton and Marriott Hotels when meetings-led full-service is the stronger asset story. Keep Westin product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the premium wellness-led full-service Westin brand stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

proposedReplacement.title: Business-Leisure Demand With Wellness Edge
proposedReplacement.body: Business and leisure hotels create Westin value when a clearer wellness story helps the property stand out in mixed-demand competitive sets. Underwrite fitness access, rooms consistency, and F&B cues that support recovery and productivity stays. Affiliation lift is strongest when the wellness edge is visible in the product—not only in brand copy.

scenarios.currentBody: Marriott Bonvoy strengthens distribution only when Westin product discipline holds after opening. Sequence PIP, systems, and training so wellness cues survive ramp-up. Avoid borrowing W or JW proof points into Westin diligence. Keep Westin product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the premium wellness-led full-service Westin brand stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

proposedReplacement.title: Premium Wellness Repositioning
proposedReplacement.body: Repositioning assets fit Westin when rooms, fitness, sleep product, and F&B can support a premium wellness promise after PIP. Owners should capitalize those elements honestly so rate can reflect Westin’s lane versus Sheraton meetings or Marriott Hotels flagship breadth. Value holds when the conversion delivers restorative product guests can feel on arrival.

scenarios.currentBody: Residence Inn creates owner value when longer-stay guests need suites, kitchens, and a residential stay rhythm—not a transient select-service box. Underwrite suite mix, social space, and operating model to extended-stay reality. Keep StudioRes, TownePlace Suites, Element, and Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy out of this diligence file unless the asset truly matches those products.

proposedReplacement.title: Longer-Stay Demand Near Anchors
proposedReplacement.body: Residence Inn creates owner value near employment, medical, education, project, and relocation anchors that generate multi-night stays. Affiliation supports recurring demand when the site sits inside those trip generators rather than relying on transient weekend leisure alone. Owner value is weaker when longer-stay demand is thin or when the competitive set already saturates suite supply.

scenarios.currentBody: Owner value rises near employment, medical, education, and relocation corridors that generate multi-night stays. Diligence competitive suite supply and length-of-stay patterns before modeling affiliation lift. CALA evidence such as Residence Inn Merida helps regional owners see extended-stay product delivery outside US-only comps. Keep Residence Inn by Marriott product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the upscale extended-stay Residence Inn suite brand stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

proposedReplacement.title: Suite And Kitchen Length-Of-Stay Economics
proposedReplacement.body: Suite-and-kitchen product creates Residence Inn value when length-of-stay economics—not short-stay select-service rate math—drive the underwriting. Owners should capitalize residential suite mix, social space, and housekeeping rhythms for multi-night guests. Affiliation helps when the asset can deliver a residential stay guests will book for weeks, not a transient all-suite night.

scenarios.currentBody: Bonvoy and Marriott systems help only when housekeeping, breakfast, and suite maintenance match Residence Inn expectations. Sequence training and PIP so residential product quality survives opening. Avoid copying SpringHill all-suite short-stay logic into Residence Inn underwriting. Keep Residence Inn by Marriott product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the upscale extended-stay Residence Inn suite brand stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

proposedReplacement.title: Suburban And Urban Extended-Stay Coverage
proposedReplacement.body: Suburban and urban extended-stay assets fit Residence Inn when Marriott distribution can support recurring corporate, medical, and relocation demand at upscale suite quality. Underwrite staffing and product depth for residential stays rather than SpringHill short-stay suite logic. Value weakens if the thesis drifts into TownePlace midscale kitchens or StudioRes prototype simplicity.

scenarios.currentBody: SpringHill Suites creates owner value when guests want suite space with select-service efficiency—not Residence Inn extended-stay kitchens or Courtyard meeting plants. Underwrite suite product and operating model together. Because CALA property evidence is limited in the current pack, treat comps as International Reference until steward-matched regional URLs are confirmed.

proposedReplacement.title: All-Suite Select-Service Demand
proposedReplacement.body: SpringHill Suites creates owner value when guests want suite space with select-service efficiency—without full extended-stay kitchens or Residence Inn residential complexity. Affiliation fits upper-midscale corridors where a broader room product can separate the asset from conventional king/queen boxes. Owner value holds when the suite story is real in floor plans, not just in marketing labels.

scenarios.currentTitle: New Build And Conversion Suite Economics
scenarios.currentBody: Owner value rises on new builds and conversions that can deliver suite sizing inside upper-midscale capital envelopes. Diligence floor plans, breakfast offering, and public-space scope before modeling affiliation lift. Keep Fairfield and Courtyard in separate files when the asset’s product story is not suite-led. Keep SpringHill Suites by Marriott product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the all-suite select-service SpringHill Suites brand stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

proposedReplacement.title: Highway Airport And Suburban Suite Coverage
proposedReplacement.body: Highway, airport, suburban, and secondary-market assets create SpringHill value when travelers need more room product than a standard select-service flag without taking on extended-stay operations. Underwrite suite sizing, breakfast scope, and public-space simplicity together. Capital returns are stronger when demand wants space and efficiency—not long-stay kitchenettes.

scenarios.currentBody: Marriott Bonvoy helps distribution only when SpringHill remains all-suite select-service. Sequence systems and training for that model, and do not borrow TownePlace or Residence Inn operating proof into SpringHill diligence. Keep SpringHill Suites by Marriott product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the all-suite select-service SpringHill Suites brand stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

proposedReplacement.title: Newbuild And Conversion Suite Positioning
proposedReplacement.body: Newbuild and conversion opportunities fit SpringHill when suite positioning can separate the asset from Fairfield and Courtyard-style competitors in the same corridor. Underwrite capital envelopes for suite product while keeping operating complexity select-service. Owner value weakens if the plan borrows TownePlace or Residence Inn longer-stay proof into an all-suite short-stay thesis.

scenarios.currentBody: TownePlace Suites creates owner value when guests need kitchens and suite space with select-service operating economics—not Residence Inn upscale residential depth or StudioRes midscale new-build prototypes. Underwrite longer-stay demand honestly. CALA evidence is limited in the current pack, so keep geography labeled International Reference until steward-matched.

proposedReplacement.title: Longer-Stay Suburban And Secondary Markets
proposedReplacement.body: TownePlace Suites creates owner value in suburban and secondary markets where multi-night guests need practical suite stays without upscale Residence Inn depth. Affiliation supports occupancy when employment and project demand is real and competitive suite supply is underwritten honestly. Owner value is weaker when the site is pure transient leisure or when capital assumes luxury residential amenities.

scenarios.currentBody: Owner value rises near employment, medical, and secondary-market corridors that generate multi-night stays. Diligence competitive suite supply and operating staffing before modeling affiliation lift. Do not reuse Residence Inn CALA examples as TownePlace proof. Keep TownePlace Suites by Marriott product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the longer-stay select-service TownePlace Suites brand stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

proposedReplacement.title: Kitchen Suites For Project And Relocation Demand
proposedReplacement.body: Kitchen-and-suite product creates TownePlace value for work crews, relocations, medical stays, education trips, and project demand that needs weeks of practical living space. Underwrite kitchenette utility, suite mix, and housekeeping for longer stays. Affiliation helps when the asset can serve those guests efficiently—not when the product is really a short-stay all-suite SpringHill.

scenarios.currentBody: Bonvoy helps only when TownePlace housekeeping and suite maintenance stay select-service disciplined. Sequence systems and training for longer-stay rhythms, and keep SpringHill all-suite short-stay logic out of this file. Keep TownePlace Suites by Marriott product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the longer-stay select-service TownePlace Suites brand stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

proposedReplacement.title: Focused Extended-Stay Operating Model
proposedReplacement.body: Owner value comes from a focused extended-stay operating model—disciplined suite product, practical public space, and select-service cost structure. Underwrite staffing and maintenance for longer-stay rhythms rather than full-service or lifestyle intensity. Value holds when TownePlace stays clearly midscale extended-stay versus Residence Inn upscale suites or StudioRes prototype newbuilds.

scenarios.currentBody: Aloft Hotels creates owner value when lifestyle design and social public space differentiate a select-service stay—without pretending to be W luxury or Moxy budget lifestyle. Underwrite lobby energy, rooms modernity, and operating efficiency together. CALA evidence such as Aloft Cancun helps regional owners see lifestyle select-service delivery.

proposedReplacement.title: Lifestyle Select-Service Urban And Airport
proposedReplacement.body: Aloft Hotels creates owner value on select-service lifestyle assets in urban, airport, and mixed-use locations where modern design and social energy can lift demand. Affiliation fits when the site can carry lifestyle rates without W-level capital or Moxy’s budget lifestyle intensity. Owner value weakens when the asset reads as a conventional Four Points box without Aloft character.

scenarios.currentTitle: Urban Airport And Secondary Lifestyle Corridors
scenarios.currentBody: Owner value rises in urban, airport, and secondary corridors where modern travelers want social space and efficient rooms. Diligence design conversion capital and F&B hours before modeling lift. Keep Element and Four Points in separate files when wellness extended-stay or classic select-service is the real thesis.

proposedReplacement.title: Social Public-Space And Bar-Led Demand
proposedReplacement.body: Social lobby and bar-led programming create Aloft value when the hotel needs more energy than a conventional select-service flag. Underwrite public-space design, F&B hours, and staffing so social space becomes a demand driver. Capital cases are stronger when guests remember the arrival experience—not when the lobby stays inert after cutover.

scenarios.currentBody: Marriott Bonvoy strengthens distribution only when Aloft character survives opening. Sequence design, systems, and training so social public space remains brand-legible through ramp-up. Keep Aloft Hotels product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the select-service lifestyle Aloft Hotels brand stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

proposedReplacement.title: Lifestyle Conversion And Newbuild Separation
proposedReplacement.body: Conversion and newbuild opportunities fit Aloft when lifestyle positioning separates the asset from Moxy, AC Hotels, Four Points, or W in the competitive set. Underwrite design narrative and rooms modernity so the brand promise is visible in product. Owner value holds when Aloft stays select-service lifestyle—energetic, efficient, and clearly not luxury lifestyle capital.

scenarios.currentBody: StudioRes creates owner value when sponsors need an affordable midscale longer-stay studio product with efficient operations—not Residence Inn upscale suites, TownePlace select-service extended stay, Element wellness, or Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy. Underwrite only what official development materials support. No CALA examples are confirmed—keep International Reference labeling.

proposedReplacement.title: Purpose-Built Extended-Stay Prototype
proposedReplacement.body: StudioRes creates owner value on purpose-built extended-stay and affordable midscale prototype opportunities where simplicity and repeatability matter more than upscale residential depth. Affiliation fits sponsors who want a clear longer-stay box without Residence Inn product intensity. Owner value is weaker when the capital plan overbuilds amenities the prototype was never meant to carry.

scenarios.currentBody: Owner value concentrates on US and Canada new-build longer-stay prototypes where studio product and staffing models stay efficient. Diligence site size, suite mix, and competitive midscale supply before modeling affiliation lift. Named references such as StudioRes Fort Myers require steward-confirmed property overview URLs before openings cards harden.

proposedReplacement.title: Longer-Stay Markets Without Full Upscale Suites
proposedReplacement.body: Markets with longer-stay demand but limited need for a full Residence Inn or TownePlace product fit StudioRes when guests want efficient studio stays at affordable midscale economics. Underwrite demand honestly against local suite supply. Affiliation helps when the competitive gap is prototype clarity—not when Element wellness or apartments-style living is the real thesis.

scenarios.currentBody: Marriott’s Longer Stays family lists StudioRes beside Residence Inn, TownePlace, and Element—use that map for distinction, never for interchangeable proof. Sequence systems and training for StudioRes midscale longer-stay realities only. Keep StudioRes product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the midscale longer-stay StudioRes by Marriott brand stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

proposedReplacement.body: Newbuild development creates StudioRes value when simplicity, repeatability, and brand clarity reduce execution risk across corridors. Underwrite construction cost, operating model, and product scope so the prototype stays disciplined after opening. Owner value holds when StudioRes remains a focused midscale extended-stay choice—not a Residence Inn, TownePlace, or Element substitute by another name.
